# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** J. A.  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001)</sub>; a crank  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>; James A.  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pettifer is short, heavy-set, and bald, except for a small strip of hair around his ears. He has a round face, bulging blue eyes, and lacks teeth in his appearance when seen angry or talking. He is considered repulsive and ugly by some neighbors.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c3 P7](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0007)_

## Personality

Mr. Pettifer is known in Brierley as an eccentric, stingy, and short-tempered man who speaks his mind candidly regardless of how direct or rude it may sound. He is extremely particular about his privacy, disliking meddling women, and manages his household without set meal times or regular dishwashing. Despite his rough, crusty exterior and impulsive temper, he possesses a soft spot for those who show him friendliness and can show a kindly, entertaining side.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c3 P10](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0010), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)_

- live peacefully without interference from women  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pettifer moved from New Brunswick to Brierley, purchasing the farm previously owned by Robert Bell. He earned an immediate reputation among locals for his eccentric household habits, short temper, and his cursing parrot, Nutmeg. When his neighbor's Jersey cow repeatedly trespassed into his oat field, he confronted Nell Harcourt in a rage. After realizing his own fence was in poor condition and admitting his hasty temper, he reconciled with Nell and accepted her offer of a home-baked nut cake. Later, when Nell mistakenly sold Mr. Pettifer's cow thinking it was her own, she confessed to him and offered her own cow in trade; Mr. Pettifer accepted the trade in good humor and hosted Nell for tea. Shortly afterward, his estranged wife, Emily, arrived unexpectedly at his home, having learned of false rumors that he was seeking a new wife. Reunited with Emily and relieved of his parrot after its death during a lightning storm, Mr. Pettifer settled into a clean, orderly life with her.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c1 P18](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0018), [v2 c2 P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 c3 P7](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0007), [v2 c3 P21](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0021), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c3 P47](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0047), [v2 c3 P51](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0051)_

## Background by volume

- originated from New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
